page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Main text in one full-width block, with marginal notes in both the left and right margins. The heading and the start of the title section follow in the main block. Gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: facere non potest: quoniam nondum plenum iudicium animi habet.a l.6.in f.l.7.

13 Mutus a, surdus b, furiosus c, itemque prodigus d cui lege bonis interdictum e est, testamentum facere non possunt: mutus, quoniam sverba ff.eod: §.3.Inst. quib. non permiss. loqui non potest: surdus, quoniam g verba familiæ emptoris exaudire non potest: furiosus, quoniam h mentem non habet, vt testari de eâ re possit: prodigus, quoniam i commercium illi interdictū k est, & ob id familiam mancipare non potest.

14 Latinus Iunianus, item is qui Deditiorum numero est testamentum facere non potest. Latinus l quidem, quoniam nominatim lege Iunia prohibitus est, is autem qui Deditiorum m numero est, quoniam ciuis Romanus testari potest, cum sit peregrinus n: nec quasi peregrinus, quoniam nullius certæ ciuitatis, sciens o vt aduersus pleges ciu tatis suæ testetur.
15 Fœminæ post duodecimum annum ætatis testamenta facere possunt tutore auctore, donec in tutela sint.
16 Seruus publicus q prætorisve, parte dimidia testamenti faciendi habet ius.
main_text.head: QVEMADMODVM HERES INSTITVI DEBEAT. Tit. XXI.
main_text.p: HERES institui redè potest his verbis s, Titius heres esto, Titius heres sit, Titium heredem esse iubeo. Illa autem institutio, v.C.de Latina libert. Latinus Iunianus testari non potest.
{v} Iunianus Latinus, post Iuniam legem, ex Latinis fit ciuis: vide tit.22.§.2.

page.notes: Marginal notes are shown in the order of their letters in the margin. Several letters and references in the margins (for example "l.6.in f.l.7", "ff.eod", "Leonis 39", "Cuiac. hic") are small and partly abbreviated; their exact wording is uncertain and marked by the note letters. The woodcut initial H of "HERES" is decorative and was read as H. Lower margin contains the gathering signature nn 4; a dot below the text is printer's ornament and not transcribed.
